title: The Bible Story: The Widow of Zarephath
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells the widow of Zarephath (1 Kings 17:7-16) and names lessons: God provides, share, trust God.

floor.question: Why should we share?
floor.answer: To help others and show love

representations: a handful of flour and a small oil bottle
contexts: sharing lunch when you have little

board.do: Write: a handful of flour, a little oil.

board.say: What happened to it after she shared?

board.do: Wait for the child to say it did not run out.

misconceptions.ask: How much food did the widow have?
misconceptions.repair: Show a tiny handful of flour. Read 1 Kings 17:12.

misconceptions.ask: Why did Elijah ask for bread first?
misconceptions.repair: Read 1 Kings 17:13-14. Elijah gave God's promise.

misconceptions.ask: What happened to the flour and oil?

misconceptions.repair: Name the prophet on a card: Elijah.

checks.question: Name a lesson from the story.
